steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: On behalf of Ægir, I hereby accept you as an Abyssal Hunter.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I will be your captain, and more than that, your teacher.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The ocean has permitted our hunt, and no pest will have anywhere to hide.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I will follow you, and I will hunt.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Arise, Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yes, Captain.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Have you ever danced before?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I attended dance classes once, but I'm not too well-practiced, Captain.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Proficiency or lack thereof does not affect the emotional reach of one's dance.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Step forward, and take my hand.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Before I formally begin your training in slaughter, I would first like for you to comprehend—

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Your life skills.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Let us begin.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Take in the rhythm. Come—
Gran Faro, Iberia

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: So... like this?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yes. Step to the rhythm, keep your feet light, and leave the rest to me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Bow, and... wave, and... twirl, and... stop.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yes, not bad, Skadi.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The captain might just be dying to be your dance partner by now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: That's not funny at all, Shark...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh, my, really?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heheh.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Seems your recovery's gone well.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: How could it not, with someone as considerate as you caring for me?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You still love to babble. No change at all.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Who else but you could praise me sooo sincerely? Do I owe you a word of thanks?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hmm, now that I think about it, I really do, don't I? A real thank-you from the heart.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: For what?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: For... caring for me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No dry-lander could ever hold me down, when the other me had the onset.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And no one else would've been able to drag me back to that hospital bed, either.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm just... so happy to have found an Abyssal Hunter on the shore.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: There's you, my captain, the captain of the Second, and I haven't seen any other Hunters.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Protecting my teammates is my duty.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: And that's that.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Thank you, Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You're welcome, Shark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Anyway, now that I've taught you the charm of dance, do you think you could teach me the secrets of song?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The other me's singing could stand to be a little easier on the ears. I want a professional to help tune me up.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I thought it was quite nice.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But I still want to sing my own song.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I can teach you. But be sure to learn, Shark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'll be a model student.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: (She breaks into melodious song.) ♪

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: (She breaks into jumping refrain.) ♪

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Lower your voice a little more. Hold your breath steady in your abdomen.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'll give it a shot.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Top of the morning, Captain.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: 2nd Captain.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Skadi, Kal'tsit's looking for you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Mm. She has a need to conduct more focused medical tests on you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Alright. I'll go now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: See you in a bit. Shark, 2nd Captain.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: What a shame, I wanted to sing a little more.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Any plans right now?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Our time is limited. We cannot return to Rhodes Island to resupply.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Kal'tsit will take charge of allocating resources aboard it.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Iberia's Saint pledges the Penal Battalion will assist our movements. They will be an important backer in our return to Ægir.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Sounds like you've got this all worked out.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Considering the scale of the Seaborn swarm, our chances of making headway into Ægir with the resources we have are dim.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But finding a path to reach a specific strategic goal is my duty as a Designer of Warfare.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: However, my worries do not end there.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ægir's cities cover the ocean, and I have been lucky to visit the majority.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But the city we saw... I have no recollection of.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I know not its scale, nor the particulars of its construction, nor whether it meets the Academy-enacted standards.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Well, that's a hump.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Thus, before we enter it, we must prepare as well as we can.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Once the time is ripe, then whatever the city's encountered, whatever developments have taken place in Ægir...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'm sure I will be able to give you both a full account.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Well, just give me a shout whenever you need something cut. Me and my saw will be waiting.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Laurentina, do you have a moment?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The sea breeze feels nice today, doesn't it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Let's take a walk, Captain.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: (She deeply inhales—and exhales—)

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Feels just great to be back to myself.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'm glad you've managed to free yourself from the Originium's effects.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I can still hear the ocean waves, after all. I can still smell the salt in the water.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'm stable for now. I can keep a hold on myself.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If I head too far from the sea though...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'm not too sure.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You needn't force yourself. You've done very well.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I've gained a new understanding of myself, actually. Odds are good the other me would eagerly devote herself to my goals.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I think me and me will get along just fine.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Kal'tsit and I have discussed this. She is to assist in resolving any intractable problems you face.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: As with the matter of Skadi, this is part of our mutual cooperation agreement.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Thank you, I mean it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Now how about we saunter ourselves out of town for a little art appreciation?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Right here.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: See it? That big, upright crag, way over yonder.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Very abstract.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Very...
Specter pauses to assemble the words to describe this unique boulder, eaten away at by the sea breeze.
From the front, it resembles an old woman cloaked in rough hemp, but with just a few steps to the side, it becomes a follower in silent prayer.
As if it is possibility itself made tangible. It is one, yet many. For a while, at least, it actually leaves her at a loss for words.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Very beautiful.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The wind erosion's endowed the sculpture with a multidimensional sort of tension.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Do you want to make it your own work?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Mine?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No, I'm not qualified.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's a complete piece already. Chiseling any more? Practically profane.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ahh, it sucks that we'd never get art like this in Ægir's cities, though.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: In the ocean, we have subjugated nature. That inherently comes with a cost.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Still, I'm happy I got to see a miracle like this.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You'd need the endorsement of an elite technician to sculpt a statue this big back in Ægir, and then you'd have to pay to use the extruder, or spend even more buying stone that works.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And then you rent one of the big sculpting tables, and make sure your sculptor's hands don't make a single damn mistake.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You shed all that blood and sweat and it's just to reach the starting line. Welcome to the next few months of your life: that stone is your baby now.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Goodbye to your everyday quibbles and daily meals. You must even forsake your flashes of inspiration with every ruthless bone in your body. Pour it all into the stone.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Give everything you have to raise it. Shave away its impurities. Breathe life into it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: In the end, it's forced to suffer the appraisal of the masses, and I know I'll hear some COMPLETELY unreasonable commentary on it.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: This is the vocation you were meant to take then?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Someone told me a joke once. Goes something like this.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Why do they call a sculptor a technician, and not an artist?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Because their main job is sculpting for the Academy, and of course those eggheads would turn artistic expression into pure science.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heh-heh~

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You're laughing quite a bit.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh, wow, am I? Whoof.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I just thought describing it like that might help you understand why I love that boulder so goddamn much.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Merely a fluke of time.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yep. A fluke achieved by time and nature.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's the coincidental things in life that make my chest jump with glee.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Mind if we sit here for a sec? I want to admire it a little more.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Captain.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Want some fin jerky?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Disclaimer: the workmanship's a little shoddy.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You mean to say hunger weighs on you?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This won't sate it. Just gives my taste buds a little stimulation, and me the joy of chewing.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It's unnecessary.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It really, really is.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Want to try?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (She takes the fin jerky.)

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Seems you're a real stranger to snacks.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (She quietly chews.)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Dry, stiff, overseasoned.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But it's convenient. It can put some of the feeling of life back in you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Every time I did well enough in my studies, my parents'd shove a bag of fin jerky just like this into my hands.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The bag WAS more refined than this, though. More vivid.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You were fortunate to have blood relatives who approved of and supported you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But they gave me plenty of grief, too.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The woman who raised me was the one tasked with planning city domes.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And my father, well, he was in charge of engineering and realizing her creations.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I am familiar with the material on your parents, from when we were recruiting Abyssal Hunters.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I always drifted wherever they went, watching the domes in my mother's blueprints gradually take shape, watching the cities sprawl out from the seabed in all directions.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Her artistic sensibilities influenced the children born under those domes, myself included.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: City after city, dome after dome.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I witnessed the majesty of creating something from nothing, plus the joy of starting all over again.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: She saved the abyssal sea, plucking it out from the nihilistic dark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And I hoped I could be someone like her.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Every city I stayed at gave me the chance to choose. Music, sport, drawing. Experiencing Ægir's rich culture in the concrete details broadened my horizons.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I thought I'd be choosing forever, until I saw that statue. It was then I decided to become a sculptor myself.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: How valuable that gigantic, flawless, snow-white figure seemed, stood before the gloom of the ocean. You gazed up at it, looked over its posture, and unconsciously, you went to mimic it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That was prayer. That was hope.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And maybe those exact hints are what made the other me so happy to accept the identity of a Church sister.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I will not judge. It was your choice.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And here I was, all ready for you to lecture me. There's a damn pity.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Being chosen to become an Abyssal Hunter far from implies that you must renounce the right to pursue your dreams.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: So what's your dream, then, Captain?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: To hold on until the light of the cities once again blankets the ocean, sit on the red velvet benches of an Ægir opera house, and watch another production.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Let us rise. We've rested for long enough. It's time we return to town.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: In a few more hours, once the sun sets, the starry sky will reveal itself.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You seem very fond of the night sky.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Specks of light flickering in the heavens, those heavens as deep and boundless as the ocean.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Aren't you a fan?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It may shake me, but not enough to make me sentimental.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It is not as if we are clueless regarding anything above sea level.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: While the little apprentice sculptor I am tried so futilely to turn an instant into an eternity, the skies had already made eternity as colorful as every instant in it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: How can I not be moved?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It seems living on dry land has awakened your passion as an artist.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This land's put me through enough agony, that's all.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Washed ashore and desiccated in the sun, taken away and filled with Originium by a bunch of sad, pathetic asses, and now I have to endure the reality of the Seaborn fraternizing with me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: So, carpe diem. I have to live it up. Use my passionate love for the arts to add a bit of seasoning to my life.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You should understand that better than I do, Captain.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Art doesn't betray, it only draws a line between beautiful and ugly.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And I'm so glad I still understand this little piece of beauty.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The town is before us. We still have many matters to deal with today.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Thank you for bringing me this momentary joy, Shark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hold on a moment.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We've got the perfect chance. I'd like you to agree to a humble request of mine.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: May I have this dance, Gladiia?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: (She presents her hand.)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It would be my honor, Laurentina.

a.text: Upon withered plains, daughters of the sea spryly begin to dance.
The sea winds provide accompaniment, while the leaves respond in kind.
For a fleeting moment, sorrow and anguish are nowhere, and life's joys fill the world.
Abyssal Hunters are bound by blood.
A dance draws to a close.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It's been so long since I shared a dance. I very much enjoyed it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Too right. And I've never danced a dance like that before.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: A moist, damp dance on dried-out meadows.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh, if it isn't the cute little Iberian bird.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: She was heading to the coast towards the lighthouse. Did she want another look at it?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The Sea Terrors there are long since annihilated. What business could she have?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Are we heading back to work now, Captain?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Many details remain to be discussed with both Kal'tsit and the old Iberian.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Then I'll keep strolling out here a little longer. Make sure our little bird returns to the nest safe and sound.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Are you lost, my poor little bird?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Oh, it's you.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Of course. Who else would call me that?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This coast is a terrible place to kill time at night.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: The Penal Battalion has the area under control, and the Sea Terrors have been swept clean. I can't imagine what there is to be frightened of.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Sometimes, for landwalkers, the waves can be more heartless than Seaborn.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The tide's coming in. Mind your feet.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Are you sure you truly understand?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Even if I didn't, I would request for you all to teach me.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: In order to respond to this calamity, I MUST learn.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Such a teacher's pet.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Tell me, then, why exactly did you come here?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I wanted to see where my maestro gave his life again.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I wanted to follow his teachings and try to overcome the fear in my heart once more.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Wh-What are you hitting my head for?!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: What a cute reaction.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heheh. Sooo energetic.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Make sense. Just what are you—

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You already have the self-confidence to face straight ahead.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Could you describe for me what's down there?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: The sea, the lighthouse, the Penal Battalion's warship. Could they not be more obvious?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Keep going. You should be able to see it.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: The reef, the lights, an unfinished column.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Aaaand?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Exactly how long do you intend to toy with me?!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Look up.
Just as Irene is about to get truly mad, Specter points into the air. Irene's line of sight follows the Abyssal Hunter's finger, and climbs through the night sky.
She sees the stars filling the firmament, and in an instant her fury vanishes.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You can still feel it, can't you, little bird?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Dreams are weighty things, and you're ready to put in what it takes.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But when your staunch beliefs pull you to battle, don't let them push life's joys to the back of your mind.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: They might be the most ordinary of things, but they really can save you.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Urgh... nngh...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heh, heh. Good little bird. That's what makes you so charming.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's time you went back to the nest. Watch your step.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Are you leaving?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Urgh, wait!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Did you need something?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I think I may have been impolite. I've simply been calling you 'you' all this time.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You're right. I don't think I've ever introduced myself.
Specter takes two steps back, and lightly lifts her skirt.
The light of the twin moons spills over the hem, the pallid glistening of the waves letting off specks of light, shining over the scripture on her parchment strips.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hello, Irene of Iberia. I am Specter, Abyssal Hunter.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If you're willing, you could also call me—Laurentina of Ægir

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Laurentina... Laurentina...

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: What a beautiful name.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Well then, see you, my strong little birdie.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: (Faintly, she hums.)

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Is she... singing?
When I pray♪
The stars wax in night♪
When I dance♪
The moons shed mournful black♪
When I smile♪
The seas will be witness to my joy♪
